verdict.rationale: Ghostty's source is publicly hosted at github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty, and community members describe building it from source. The repo also states that 'anyone can use libghostty' to build or embed terminals, which implies open reuse. However, no evidence item names the license or confirms it is an OSI-approved open license. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or SPDX statement), first-party docs on source licensing terms.
